attchmntText: Donear Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary i.e ' Donear Lifestyle Limited'.
voiceSummary: Donear Industries Limited incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named Donear Lifestyle Limited on 26th November 2026. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs issued the Certificate of Incorporation on the same day. The new entity operates in the textiles industry. Its authorized share capital is Rs. 5,00,000. Donear Industries Limited holds 100% share capital of the subsidiary. The subsidiary is classified as a related party. It has not yet commenced business operations. Consequently, turnover and net worth are not applicable. The incorporation aligns with the company's strategic objective to expand its business. Initial share capital was subscribed at face value. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required. The information has been disclosed on the company website.

attchmntText: Vedanta Oil and Gas Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: Vedanta Oil and Gas Limited received an order from the Principal Commissioner of Customs, Mundra, Gujarat, dated November 26, 2026. The order imposes aggregate penalties of INR 54,38,12,218 along with certain demands. This action relates to alleged non-payment of Anti-Dumping Duty on certain Bill of Entries and alleged non-compliance with the applicable Quality Control Order regarding the import of specified category of OCTG items. The company is evaluating the order and considering appropriate legal remedies, including filing an appeal before the appellate authority. The maximum financial impact is limited to the penalty levied.

attchmntText: Prabha Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Prabha Energy Limited filed an investor presentation with BSE and NSE on November 27, 2026. The filing follows an intimation dated November 25, 2026, regarding analyst interactions scheduled for December 1, 2026, and December 2, 2026. The presentation outlines the company's onshore exploration and production activities, focusing on Coal Bed Methane and Marginal Gas Fields. Commercial production at the North Karanpura block started in May 2025. Commercial production for the Jharia block is targeted for Q4 FY27. The company holds a 25% participating interest in North Karanpura and a 90% interest in Jharia. The presentation also details estimated CBM reserves of 31 BCM and highlights India's natural gas infrastructure investment plans.

attchmntText: Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Gyftr Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice dated November 27, 2026, seeking shareholder approval for material related party transactions. The resolutions are placed before members for approval via remote e-voting facilitated by National Securities Depository Limited. The e-voting period commences on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 9:00 A.M. and ends on Sunday, December 27, 2026, at 5:00 P.M. The proposed resolutions include approval for transactions with Mufin Green Finance Limited up to Rs. 100 Crores, Hindon Mercantile Limited up to Rs. 1000 Crores, and Mufinpay Payment Solutions Private Limited up to Rs. 100 Crores during the financial year 2026-27. M/s. Abhay K & Associates have been appointed as Scrutinizer. The results of the Postal Ballot will be submitted to stock exchanges within two working days from the conclusion of the e-voting period.

attchmntText: V-Guard Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: V-Guard Industries Limited published a notice in The Hindu Business Line and Deepika on November 27, 2026, regarding the transfer of equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority. Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority awarded a 76.92 crore contract to Leena Powertech Engineers for shore power infrastructure at Gateway Terminals India. Gold loan companies are shifting focus to collections as falling gold prices push loan-to-value ratios higher. The Reserve Bank of India study indicates the West Asia conflict caused stronger oil price shocks and rupee depreciation than the Russia-Ukraine conflict. attchmntText: Awfis Space Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Appointment of Mr. Kumar Alok Gupta (Chief Business Officer) as Senior Management Personnel of the company w.e.f. November 16, 2026.
voiceSummary: Awfis Space Solutions Limited has approved the appointment of Mr. Kumar Alok Gupta as Senior Management Personnel with effect from November 16, 2026. The Board of Directors made this decision based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Gupta currently serves as the Chief Business Officer. He is a full-time employee with over 24 years of experience in commercial real estate. Prior to joining Awfis, he was Managing Director at Cushman and Wakefield and Associate Executive Director at CBRE India. The company disclosed this information under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations. The details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Singer India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 62500 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on November 27, 2026
voiceSummary: Singer India Limited intimates the allotment of 62,500 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 2 each pursuant to the exercise of vested stock options under the ESOP 2023 plan. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee accorded consent via circular on 27th November 2026. The shares were allotted at an exercise price of Rs. 75 per share, with a total amount received of Rs. 4,68,75,00. A lock-in period of six months applies from the date of allotment. The total issued share capital increases to Rs. 12,45,63,234, representing 6,22,81,617 equity shares. The allotment date is recorded as 27.11.2026. The shares are identical to existing equity shares and rank pari-passu. This intimation is filed in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations and SEBI SBEB Regulations 2021.
